label: For "Closing Process Delay Prediction": Predict which home purchases will miss their closing date and why, so agents and lenders chase the right items. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Outcomes after action, because coordinators chase risky deals and thereby change the result.
